description: Crop an image into a circle, oval or rounded-corners shape with transparent corners for avatars, logos and profile pictures. Supports zoom, horizontal/vertical offset, corner radius and target pixel size. Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.002/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/circle-crop-image.
